orientation_basis: the owner's list is not marked away-first, so ORIENTATION IS TAKEN FROM THE REGISTERED CARD and only the scores are read from the relay. Scores attach to the named team, so every winner is unambiguous either way: DAL over SEA, IND over CHI, WAS over PDX, LVA over TOR. Three of the four are away wins under both readings; SEA@DAL is the only row where the orderings differ, and the card settles it.
identity_binding: the relay writes POR and LV; the card writes PDX and LVA. Both bind to one canonical id through franchise_identity, which is the amendment-8 case arriving the day it was written — before binding, two of these four games would have failed to pair silently.
